basis: renders a bare <div> — inline-flow geometry only, no semantics of its own.

responsive.basis: the gap scale steps at Tailwind's sm (8→12, 12→16, 16→24); with wrap the line breaks onto a second row once children stop fitting, with nowrap the row stays one line and overflows — both witnessed by the component's own harness spec.

harness.because: conformance throws loudly on wrap/baseline misuse — behavioural evidence beyond the none row, kept because it is how the composition's layout is proven
